limitations.detail: A pretrained model's latent technical knowledge cannot be erased. Admissibility therefore requires packet evidence for every claimed concept and treats unsupported knowledge as PREMATURE_KNOWLEDGE.

A client-only GitHub Pages application cannot cryptographically hide bundled local answer keys. Browser gates can prevent visible, DOM, and accessibility-tree leakage before an attempt; high-stakes secrecy requires a server-side assessment service.
Lessons needing credentials, paid services, unavailable hardware, or third-party state must use approved fixtures or report BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT.
No new real human-subject study is available in this automated run; the held-out human-reviewed calibration set remains the available calibration evidence.
The user explicitly authorized external learner packet evaluation.

Superseded on CAMP-20260820-02. Learner turns run through a Claude CLI session started with --tools "" --safe-mode --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources "" --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence, in a disposable directory outside the repository. The runner reads the CLI's own init event and refuses any turn whose tools, mcp_servers, slash_commands, skills or plugins are non-empty; StructuredOutput is the only permitted entry because it is the schema response channel. Learner runs are therefore E2 rather than E1 diagnostic.

scripts/student_runtime.py provides the isolated per-attempt runtime and binds each execution to a receipt (request, code, stdin, runtime, command, stdout, stderr, exit code, digest). The sealer fills observed_output from the receipt and fails closed on fabricated, replayed, tampered or mis-bound results.

The isolated student runtime executes stdlib-only Python. Exercises needing pip installs, network access, Git, GitHub CLI or a real shell still return BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT rather than a receipt, so S01 practical steps remain unverifiable by execution.
